passage.label: Prophet frowned turned away; came blind man interrupting; what make you perceive perhaps purified; reminded remembrance benefit him; thinks himself without need; give attention; not upon you blame if not purified; came striving knowledge; fears Allah; from him distracted; No Indeed verses reminder; whoever wills remember it; recorded honored sheets; exalted purified; carried hands messenger-angels; noble dutiful

mainSubject.label: The Prophet rebuked for frowning and turning away when the blind man interrupted, since he might have been purified or benefited by remembrance; the self-sufficient one receiving attention while the striving God-fearer is distracted from — yet no blame attaches if the former refuses purification; these verses are a reminder for whoever wills, recorded in honoured, exalted and purified sheets carried by noble and dutiful messenger-angels

subordinateSubjects.label: The Prophet frowned and turned away
Because the blind man came to him interrupting
What would make you perceive that he might be purified
Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him
As for the one who thinks himself without need
To him you give your attention
Yet no blame rests upon you if he refuses purification
But as for the one who came striving for knowledge
No — indeed these verses are a reminder
So whoever wills may remember it
Carried by the hands of messenger-angels

commandsAndProhibitions.description: The Prophet frowned and turned away — a prophetic correction.
